_note: Verses were checked against aldiwan.net, diwanalarab.com and mawdoo3.com. Original hemistich text of the first four is unchanged from the old site. Tashkeel for the Abu Firas verses was added by hand (sources print them bare). English renderings are original translations.

hemistichs: عَلَى قَدْرِ أَهْلِ الْعَزْمِ تَأْتِي الْعَزَائِمُ
verses.translation: Resolutions arrive in proportion to the people of resolve, and noble deeds arrive in proportion to the noble.

hemistichs: مِنَ الْحُسْنِ حَتَّى كَادَ أَنْ يَتَكَلَّمَا
verses.translation: Radiant spring has come to you, strutting and laughing, so lovely it all but began to speak.

poet.ar: من شعر زهير بن أبي سلمى

hemistichs: وَمَنْ يَجْعَلِ المَعْرُوفَ فِي غَيْرِ أَهْلِهِ
verses.translation: Whoever places kindness where it does not belong will find his praise turned to blame, and will regret it.

note.ar: في الحكمة ووضع الأمور في نصابها
note.en: On wisdom and putting things in their proper place

verses.translation: If you venture toward a noble goal, do not settle for anything less than the stars.
The horses, the night and the desert know me, and so do the sword, the spear, the paper and the pen.

hemistichs: أَما لِلهَوى نَهيٌ عَلَيكَ وَلا أَمرُ
verses.translation: I see you restrained in tears, patience your nature — has love no say over you, no command?

hemistichs: إِذا مِتُّ ظَمآناً فَلا نَزَلَ القَطرُ
verses.translation: You console me with promises of union while death stands before it — if I die thirsty, let no rain fall.

hemistichs: لَنا الصَّدرُ دونَ العالَمينَ أَوِ القَبرُ
verses.translation: We are a people with no middle ground: the foremost place among all the worlds, or the grave.
I kept my soul from whatever would stain it, and rose above the gifts of every base man.

hemistichs: يا سَيِّداً بِوِدادِهِ مازِلتُ مَلآنَ اليَدَينِ
إِن غِبتَ عَنّي أَو حَضَرتَ فَيا لَها مِن حُسنَيَينِ
verses.translation: O master, whose affection has always filled my hands — absent or present, how fair both states are.
You whom the wine has swayed — how gentle these ways of yours are.
